messages.message:
Purchase premium credit through payments via micropayment. The desired services must be activated and configured with the provider (Service: Event).
Warning: For security reasons, use should only be enabled on Apache web servers.
Payments can only be registered if the deposit options specified above apply to EUR. Other currencies are currently not supported.
Required configuration settings for payment services:
API URL: http://www.meinedomain.de/websoccer/webservices/micropayment/index.php
GET parameters:
amount=__amount__
free=__$freeparam__
Provided when configuring a project at www.micropayment.de.
Provided when you log in to micropayment.de and open "Project and payment management".
